title: BLS12-381 G1 ECDLP (n=1048576, W(n)=W_cold) at 2^108.954600 G1 Units (Mode-A K=2 L_{3/4}(b) Exact-R_cov + Cold-Path 2D NP Gate No-Direct1 + Surplus-6 L-LA Trimming at B=(72.00,72.36)/exc=0.605 + Single-Tier 2D-56b NTT3 + Bottom-Up DP E_16 Gram-Ellipsoid LX=68.25 & Kronecker-NTT3 Stage-2 ECM Descent)

claims.statement: Under the declared exploratory-v1 STNFS heuristics (H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H-EA, H-ECM, H-R, H-SM, H-X, H-FFT) and the abstract flat-RAM scalar ARMv8.1-A + disclosed FEAT_LSE STADDB/STADD cost model, BLS12-381 G_1 ECDLP with auxiliary powers (bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: given 1 <= n < r, A_i = [s^i mod r] P_0 for 1 <= i <= n, and T = [s] P_0 = A_1 with uniform s in 1..r-1; scored at n = 1048576 = 2^20; ignoring A_2..A_n so W_G1(n) = W_cold holds for all 1 <= n < r) is solved via pairing transfer (g = e(P_0, Q_0), z_T = e(T, Q_0)) and two calibrated gamma_0-blinded G_T virtual logarithms with cold-run success probability >= 0.391 > 0.39 (post-headroom floor p_floor = 0.999, K_gate = 7219896829650084767) in gated expected cost E[W_G1(n)] <= 2^108.95441202 < 2^108.954600 G_1-reference units (log2 bound 108.954600 = 544773/5000 at n = 1048576, C_G1 = 2,000 Ir/u = 10x core at C = 20,000 Ir/u; core E[W_run] <= 2^106.9858 core u, core E[W] < 2^105.632700 core u, hard meter W_G1(n) <= 10*(2^124 + 2^66) < 2^127.321929 G_1 u). No prior verdict or score is a premise.
